task.title: M9: Churn heatmap (modules by week)
task.description:
A grid view with modules on the vertical axis and time buckets (weeks by default, --bucket day|week|month) on the horizontal axis, each cell colored by lines changed (or commits) in that module during that bucket. Reveals active fronts, abandoned areas, and the module touched every single week. Data comes from the git history pass that already computes churn, extended to retain per-bucket totals per directory for the --since window instead of collapsing to a single number. Row ordering: by total churn, with a toggle for tree order. Hover shows the count and the commit list for that cell.

Acceptance criteria:
- 'Heatmap' view in the view switcher, hash param view=heatmap; data is part of the snapshot so it works on the static export and is cached per SHA.
- Snapshot gains a churnBuckets section (module id, bucket start, lines, commits); snapshot size growth for workbook with --since 1y stays under 20%.
- Rows collapse to top-level dirs by default with click to expand one level, so repos with hundreds of dirs are usable.
- One test on bucket aggregation.
